seed_ledger.name: Fermi America HyperGrid lateral (Energy Transfer)
seed_ledger.reason: Fermi's October 2025 release and its FY2025 annual report say the campus near Amarillo will tie into an Energy Transfer pipeline just south of the campus, with firm supply of up to about 300,000 MMBtu per day and a Q1 2026 target, at minimal capital cost. No source gives an off-site length, route, diameter or regulator filing. The only pipe length found is about 4.6 miles on the campus itself, which is out of scope. A trade report also says the project is largely stalled with no tenant, so volumes are contingent. Looks like a tap, not a new lateral. Sources checked: (1) EIA workbook not re-checked this pass; (2) FERC and Federal Register search found only unrelated Panhandle Eastern notices; (3) Railroad Commission search found no Fermi permit; (4) air permit 181009 covers the plant only, no pipeline named; (5) none, no utility involved; (6) county records show only a tax abatement; (7) Fermi 10-K and Energy Transfer investor materials list the interconnect with no length; (8) trade press repeats the release. Search failed to continue after the shared web search budget ran out. Searches run: 9.

evidence.note: Oct 2025 trade press: tie-in to Energy Transfer pipeline south of campus, service Q1 2026
Fermi FY2025 annual report: firm gas supply with Energy Transfer, up to about 300,000 MMBtu per day
